One Yonyon studio entity, not two

The docs page orchestkit.yonyon.ai/yonyon resolves the studio brand inside the OrchestKit docs. The apex brand site yonyon.ai/yonyon declares the same studio as an Organization with url: https://yonyon.ai. Before this change the docs page minted its own Organization whose official website pointed only at the docs subdomain, so a crawler could read two competing studio entities (GH-4144).

{
  "@type": "Organization",
  "@id": "https://orchestkit.yonyon.ai/#yonyon",
  "name": "Yonyon",
  "url": "https://orchestkit.yonyon.ai/yonyon",
  "mainEntityOfPage": "https://orchestkit.yonyon.ai/yonyon",
  "sameAs": ["https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141457913"]
}

Official website = docs subdomain. The apex brand site already declares https://yonyon.ai/#organization for the same studio, so this minted a second entity with a conflicting url.

{
  "@type": "Organization",
  "@id": "https://yonyon.ai/#organization",
  "name": "Yonyon",
  "url": "https://yonyon.ai",
  "mainEntityOfPage": "https://orchestkit.yonyon.ai/yonyon",
  "sameAs": [
    "https://yonyon.ai",
    "https://yonyon.ai/yonyon",
    "https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141457913"
  ]
}

Same entity IRI the apex brand page declares, apex official website, docs subdomain kept as the page url and demoted out of the identity slot.

Check the alignment rules

Run the three rules from the issue against the currently shown node.

showing: before

  • Visible cross-link: the page links https://yonyon.ai/yonyon and https://yonyon.ai with the copy that it is the same Yonyon AI studio, not the DJ.
  • The Organization url is the apex studio site, so there is no official website that points only at the docs subdomain.
  • sameAs references the apex studio (site and brand page); the docs subdomain appears only as the page's own url (mainEntityOfPage), not as a competing identity anchor.

The visible change on the page

The studio also owns the apex brand site: yonyon.ai, with the studio page at yonyon.ai/yonyon. Same Yonyon AI studio, not the DJ: one identity, published on both domains.

Rendered as a real paragraph on /yonyon, and mirrored into /yonyon.md and the llms.txt publisher line so agents that never render HTML read the same crosslink.

Where the change lives

  • docs/site/lib/constants.ts: YONYON gains apex and apexPage; url stays the docs page.
  • docs/site/components/structured-data.tsx: YONYON_ORG_ID reuses the apex entity IRI; url and sameAs reference the apex.
  • docs/site/app/(home)/yonyon/page.tsx: visible apex crosslink paragraph.
  • docs/site/lib/page-markdown.ts and docs/site/app/llms.txt/route.ts: the same crosslink for agents.
